summary: Move the existing CDEK reference from planned to the separate Delivery verification surface and add a Деловые Линии SDK adapter with appkey/PAT health checks; shipment operations remain qualification-gated.

impacts.evidence: Both providers bind credentials to one tenant-scoped connector account; no caller-supplied tenant override is accepted.
CDEK client secrets and the Деловые Линии PAT stay behind SecretProvider; access/session tokens and provider payloads are discarded after health checks.
No public endpoint is added; the existing connector-account create/enroll/check control plane is reused.
No event or canonical envelope is added.
The new adapter and CDEK host transport use the frozen Connector SDK v1 and existing additive logistics interfaces.
Provider-neutral connector accounts and health history are reused; no provider-specific table is introduced.
The host uses TLS-verified public-destination-only requests, callback-scoped secrets, and bounded token/session probes.
No shipment, cancellation, return or label operation is admitted; future writes require capability, policy and approval evidence.
Health checks continue to use the connector.account.connection_checked audit event with safe status metadata only.
SDK candidates retain deterministic conformance probes; no remote write retry or scheduler route is enabled.
Only fixed HTTPS health endpoints are called; no arbitrary callback or webhook ingress is introduced.
Manifest timeouts/retry metadata and normalized provider-unavailable health states bound both probes.
Runtime support can disable either Delivery entry without a destructive migration or data rollback.
Deterministic CDEK and Деловые Линии connector tests plus the required conformance reports pass without production credentials or network access.
